name: Tanpopo ~Everything Nice~
source:
Unhappiness can come to anyone.

The protagonist belongs to the volunteer club along with his two childhood friends, his best friend and an upperclassman.
Everybody happily engages in the club activities, but various misfortunes start to happen.
translation:
不幸可能降临在任何人身上。

主人公和他的两位青梅竹马、一位挚友以及一位学长一起加入了志愿者社团。每个人都愉快地参加着社团活动，但各种不幸开始接踵而至。
